notes: v3.0.44 - The pull now keeps working while you watch it. Before this, glancing at the MLS tab during a pull quietly switched the reads back to hidden mode for the rest of the day - exactly the mode that fails on charts Athena has not painted yet. Now watching the MLS tab counts as being present: the reads keep bringing Athena forward and finish on the first pass. Clicking away to anything else still pauses the assist (your choice always wins), it never runs while you are recording a visit, and it never acts when you are outside Chrome. The completion banner also tells the truth per read now: if some reads ran hidden and could not finish, it says so instead of staying quiet. Everything from v3.0.43 remains. Requires Chrome 116+.
